Constant integer up and lower bound(inclusive). Useful for value bound analysis.
Represent integer constrains including (integer) variables, their ranges and the relations between th...

We can have different set of variables to represent the same constraints. For example, the following two systems are equivalent, {a + b = 0 | a >= 0, b >= 0} and {m - n = 0 | m >= 0, n <= 0} This data structure represents the transformation between two equivalent linear systems. In the above example, src : {a + b = 0 | a >= 0, b >= 0} dst : {m - n = 0 | m >= 0, n <= 0} src_to_dst : {a -> m, b -> -n} dst_to_src : {m -> a, n -> -b}.

Represent integer grouped bounds which are classified into lower bounds (inclusive), upper bounds (inclusive) and equalities. It also contains coefficient as a multiplier for the bounds, i.e., coef * var >= lower coef * var == equal coef * var <= upper.
